schema_version.description: Mandatory current attempt contract discriminator; immutable v2 rows are legacy-untrusted history.

payload_sha256.description: Mandatory hash of the complete ledger payload.

capability_observation.description: Optional parent-observed focused platform capability result.

execution_read_manifest_identity.description: Reducer-bound identity of the trusted compiled execution read manifest.

raw_award_receipt.description: Closed success-only worker receipt retained as canonical raw proof bytes.

raw_award_receipt_sha256.description: Worker self-hash of the exact canonical raw award receipt bytes.

parent_attestation.description: Separately named parent attestation over completion and process facts.

unattested_partial.description: Non-awarding partial worker observation retained for failed supervision.

result.description: Select attempts eligible for a run award.

raw_award_receipt.description: Successful attempts retain the exact closed raw award receipt.

raw_award_receipt_sha256.description: Successful attempts retain the worker self-hash.

unattested_partial.description: A successful attempt cannot also be an unattested partial.

redaction.description: Closed marker for externally controlled text removed from public records.

content_sha256.description: Digest of the exact canonical JSON diagnostic value.

diagnostic_key.description: JSON-style key locating the exact value inside the sidecar.

stream_sha256.description: Exact parent-observed stream digest when the value is a stdio tail.

evidence.description: Mandatory literal evidence and coverage record.

execution.description: Mandatory execution identity and currentness state.

authority_epoch.description: Live environment-authority discriminator; null for audit-only legacy attempts.

environment_content_sha256.description: Complete content-manifest digest promoted into the live generation.

selected_interpreter_relative_path.description: Selected interpreter lexical path relative to the sealed prefix.

external_escape_records.description: Exact regular-file targets reached by sealed-prefix symlink escapes.

items.description: One external regular-file escape target bound by path and digest.

observed_recipe_revision.description: Worker-observed recipe revision, required for parent comparison.

observed_adapter_sha256.description: Worker-observed typed-adapter digest, or null for declarative recipes.

observed_code_manifest_sha256.description: Worker-observed digest over the recursive code_manifest bytes, or null when the recipe has no code manifest.

observed_input_asset_sha256.description: Worker-observed digest of the materialized standard input asset, or null when no standard asset was selected.

constructor_seconds.description: Worker-observed model-construction wall seconds, or null when the constructor did not complete.

forward_seconds.description: Worker-observed forward wall seconds for this mode, or null when the forward did not run.

output_value_sha256.description: Canonical worker-observed output-value digest when representable.

checkpoint_or_weight_read_attempted.description: Mandatory checkpoint or weight read attempted.

reason_code.description: Mandatory closed reason code when applicable.

request_nonce.description: Fresh parent-issued request nonce echoed by the worker.

request_sha256.description: Digest of the exact worker request bytes.

stable_id.description: Trusted stable model identity bound into the request.

work_id.description: Deterministic work identity bound into the request.

observation.description: Closed worker-internal constructor, input, forward, signature, and policy observations.

request_nonce.description: Fresh request nonce observed by the parent.

request_sha256.description: Digest of the exact request launched by the parent.

completion_line_sha256.description: Digest of the exact worker completion line when present.

named_raw_award_receipt_sha256.description: Raw receipt digest literally named by the completion line.

timed_out.description: Whether the parent enforced the timeout.

rss_exceeded.description: Whether the parent enforced the RSS limit.

stdout_sha256.description: Digest of captured standard output bytes.

stderr_sha256.description: Digest of captured standard error bytes.

attestation_sha256.description: Digest of the canonical parent attestation bytes.

stage.description: Stage reached before supervision was lost.

reason_code.description: Typed reason for retaining only partial evidence.

diagnostic_sha256.description: Optional digest of redacted diagnostic sidecar bytes.
